name: zw-payroll-social
description: Zimbabwe payroll and social contributions, tax year 2026: PAYE in USD and ZWG, 3% AIDS levy, NSSA pension 4.5% each on a USD 700 ceiling, workers compensation by industry, ZIMDEF, the monthly PAYE return due on the 5th and payment on the 10th, and the long return in TaRMS. Use for questions such as Zimbabwe payroll, ZIMRA PAYE, P2 return, NSSA contributions, P4 form or what does an employee cost in Zimbabwe. Individual returns are in zw-income-tax.
